description: Transcription by instantiation (AGENTS.md invariant 16): the proof only applies the assumed n-to-(n−1) decrement premise four times (5→4→3→2→1) over an uninterpreted `Nat → Prop` count predicate, with both the five-causable premise and the decrement premise as explicit open hypotheses. It certifies only that the A7c count step was transcribed; it closes no frontier node by itself and leaves STMT-NB-ONE-CONTINGENT-POSSIBLY-CAUSEABLE open while its premises are open. Not a proof of noncontingent or necessary existence.
